stories.title: Ukraine deploys new FP-7 tactical ballistic missile in combat for the first time
stories.summary: Zelenskiy said Ukraine's FP-7 tactical ballistic missile saw its first combat use, calling it a step toward ramping up production after earlier test successes. It marks a milestone in Ukraine's domestic missile program as it counters Russian strikes.

stories.title: Putin says continuation of international conflicts is highly likely
stories.summary: Putin said international conflicts would 'highly likely' continue as the global order shifts and Western hegemony wanes, while warning that catastrophic scenarios must be avoided. The remarks come amid multiple active flashpoints worldwide.

stories.title: Israeli settlers kill Palestinian in West Bank, say officials
stories.summary: Palestinian officials said armed Israeli settlers shot two people in the village of Yasuf, killing a 51-year-old man. The UN says more than 80 Palestinians have been killed in the West Bank so far in 2026 amid a surge in violence.

stories.title: Explosions heard overnight in Ethiopia's capital Addis Ababa
stories.summary: Diplomatic sources told Reuters that explosions rang out overnight in Addis Ababa, with an opposition alliance claiming it launched drone strikes on the capital. The assault ramps up a conflict in northern Ethiopia that began last week.

stories.title: Google says Gemini 4 Argon can find and patch critical software flaws
stories.summary: Google unveiled Gemini 4 Argon, a frontier model it says can locate, validate and patch critical software vulnerabilities without human help, rolling it out first to cyber defenders via its Fairwind Program. A version without cyber guardrails goes to defenders and internal teams, with broader access later.

stories.title: IBM brings its 'Bob' agentic coding platform to self-hosted deployments
stories.summary: IBM announced self-hosted deployment for Bob, its agentic software-development platform, letting enterprises run it on-premises, in private or sovereign clouds, or air-gapped environments. It targets organizations needing data residency and AI governance control.

stories.title: Commentary: error-prone AI nearly sparked a world war this month
stories.summary: Timnit Gebru and Emily M. Bender argue rush-deployed, unreliable AI systems nearly triggered a catastrophic escalation this month, warning that 'superintelligence' hype is distracting from near-term harms. It's a call for caution over frontier-model overconfidence.

stories.title: Steelers vs Browns: prediction, odds, injuries and how to watch
stories.summary: Pittsburgh visits Cleveland for Thursday Night Football as an AFC North clash where both teams sit 2-1 and a win puts the victor alone in first. The Steelers traded cornerback Joey Porter Jr. to Dallas and the Browns lose center Elgton Jenkins.

stories.title: Browns-Steelers predictions for Thursday night, plus Joey Porter Jr. trade grade
stories.summary: CBS analysts split their picks for the Steelers-Browns Thursday night game, noting Cleveland has won nine straight Thursday night home games. The newsletter also grades the Steelers' late-night trade of cornerback Joey Porter Jr. to Dallas.

stories.title: Suddenly hot Browns with Deshaun Watson take on the Steelers
stories.summary: Winners of two straight, the Browns can move into sole possession of first place in the AFC North with a Thursday night win at home vs Pittsburgh. Deshaun Watson has been sharper of late, though Cleveland's ground game remains the league's worst.

stories.title: Aaron Rodgers leads Steelers into Thursday night clash at Browns
stories.summary: Aaron Rodgers is one win from tying Tom Brady's Thursday night QB record as Pittsburgh faces Cleveland in their 150th all-time meeting. The Steelers are 0-9 in divisional road games on Thursdays; Cleveland has won seven straight on short rest.

stories.title: Ohio State vs Iowa preview by the numbers
stories.summary: No. 5 Ohio State travels to No. 14 Iowa for its first big Big Ten road test at Kinnick Stadium, where its top-ranked passing game meets Iowa's No. 1 scoring defense. The Buckeyes are 14.5-point favorites in a top-15 showdown that hosts College GameDay.

stories.title: Ohio State vs Iowa preview: who has the edge?
stories.summary: Breaking down the No. 5 Buckeyes' Saturday game at No. 14 Iowa, with OSU's passing game and Heisman contender Jeremiah Smith against Iowa's stingy run defense. It's Ohio State's first trip to Kinnick Stadium since 2017.

stories.title: No. 5 Ohio State takes on No. 14 Iowa
stories.summary: Ryan Day says the trip to Kinnick Stadium is a chance to build momentum, as the 3-1 Buckeyes face 4-0 Iowa in a ranked road matchup where College GameDay will broadcast. OSU star receiver Jeremiah Smith is coming off a career-best 217-yard, four-touchdown game.

stories.title: Three things to know about Ohio State vs Iowa
stories.summary: College GameDay heads to Iowa City for the second time in five weeks for OSU's game, and receiver Jeremiah Smith needs 10 catches and two TDs to break the program's receptions and receiving-touchdown records. Iowa enters on a hard-fought win over Michigan.

stories.title: F1 approves shorter races for 2027 to fit revised power unit plan
stories.summary: Formula 1 has approved shorter race formats for 2027, part of a revised power unit plan aimed at making events more sustainable. The move reshapes the race weekend structure for the next F1 generation.

stories.title: Mercedes and Aston Martin go head-to-head in charity football match
stories.summary: Mercedes and Aston Martin's teams faced off in a charity football match, with results coming from the paddock fundraiser. It's a rare form break amid the F1 calendar.

stories.title: Red Bull admits Verstappen's mysterious car issue can't be fully fixed until 2027
stories.summary: Red Bull said an unexplained handling problem afflicting Max Verstappen's car can only be fully resolved next season. The admission signals the issue could weigh on the team for the rest of the 2026 campaign.

stories.title: Columbus Blue Jackets open NHL season at home against Buffalo Sabres
stories.summary: The Columbus Blue Jackets kick off the 2026-27 NHL season at Nationwide Arena against the Buffalo Sabres. It's the annual home opener for the metro's NHL team.

stories.title: New $33 million Kroger store opens in Delaware, Ohio
stories.summary: Kroger opens a $33 million, 118,000-square-foot store in Delaware on Oct. 2, its third new central Ohio location since 2024, with opening-week giveaways and fuel discounts. It's part of a $97 million grocery investment across central and northwest Ohio.

stories.title: Central Ohio communities set trick-or-treat times for Halloween
stories.summary: Communities across central Ohio have published their 2026 trick-or-treat dates and times as Halloween approaches. Parents now have a rundown of when neighborhoods in Columbus, Gahanna and nearby suburbs will host trick-or-treat.
